verify.subject: Verify your DeCave email
verify.heading: Verify your DeCave email
verify.body: Confirm this email address to activate your account.

reset.subject: Reset your DeCave password
reset.heading: Reset your DeCave password
reset.body: If you requested a password reset, use the button below.

signInAlert.subject: New sign-in to your DeCave account
signInAlert.heading: New sign-in to DeCave
signInAlert.usedOnText: Your DeCave account was just used to sign in on: {{device}}
signInAlert.usedOn: Your account was just used to sign in on:
signInAlert.ifYou: If this was you, you don't need to do anything.
signInAlert.notYouText: If it wasn't you, secure your account now (signs out every device and sends a password reset link): {{link}}
signInAlert.turnOffText: You can turn these emails off in {{settingsPath}}.
signInAlert.footer: That signs out every device and emails you a password reset link. The link works for 7 days. Turn these emails off in {{settingsPath}}.

emailChanged.subject: Your DeCave email address was changed
emailChanged.heading: Your DeCave email address changed
emailChanged.changedText: The email address on your DeCave account was changed to {{newEmail}}.
emailChanged.changed: The email address on your account was changed to {{newEmail}}.
emailChanged.notYou: If you did not make this change, sign in to DeCave, change your password and sign out other devices in {{settingsPath}}.
